paragraphs: Rav Idi bar Idi (bar Gershom), Chullin 98a; Rav Huna son of Rav Idi, Rosh Hashanah 24b; Rav Hoshaya son of Rav Idi, Yevamot 36b; Chalafa bar Idi, Vayikra Rabbah ch. 16, section 1; Rabbi Chinena bar Idi, Shabbat 63a; Rabbi Chinena bar Idi (a Tanna), Shevuot 34b; Rav Chanilai bar Idi, Ketubot 79a, and Yoma 22b: Rabbi Nehilai bar Idi; Rav Yehuda bar Idi, Rosh Hashanah 31a; Rabbi Yehoshua son of Rav Idi, Berakhot 4a; Rabbi Yaakov bar Idi, Berakhot 29b; Mar bar Idi, Yevamot 106b; Rav Machseya bar Idi, Yoma 2a; Rav Mesharshiya son of Rav Idi, Gittin 30b; Rav Ilaa son of Rav Idi, Bava Kamma 42a; Rav Simi son of Rav Idi, Menachot 25a; Rav Shisha or Rav Sheshet son of Rav Idi, Berakhot 17b, Shabbat 138b.

notes.text: This is a list indexed by the father-name Idi. Its separate sons do not establish that all the fathers named Idi are one person.

The directly consulted Chullin 98a chain names Rav Idi bar Idi bar Gershom. This supports that occurrence, not an identification of all fathers called Idi in the index. The listed sons, titles and alternative names remain separate.
